(merge-base 813f08a; gh compare: diverged, 3 ahead / 2 behind), so

consistency conflict. Its only net content difference vs main is
integration-candidate.json (release-integration.yml and README.md are
byte-identical on both lines).

merged connector tip is a linear descendant of 7c7093d and content-
equivalent to df1f4378:
  core    2adae47a -> 1861ed07 (exact v0.4.26 Core anchor; main value is
          rejected by scripts/ecosystem_release_pins.py:25 candidate.core==core)
  demo    896dc3c  -> 25c31969 (D0)
  console PENDING  -> 69d1d14  (U0)

Supersedes connector PR #9 (head 2223506c), which kept the wrong Core
SHA at integration-candidate.json:4.

(replacing historical anchor df1f4378 at lines 7,14,21,25,35) and pull
